verification_rationale: The source explicitly sets the income ceiling at 60% of AMI and limits eligible household sizes to one through four people, matching the claim. The source describes the homes as rental apartments and does not qualify the stated criteria further.
applicability_requirements: Applicants must occupy the unit as their primary residence.
source_page_text: Cedar Row Apartments offers income-restricted rental homes. To qualify, household gross annual income must not exceed 60% of area median income (AMI), adjusted for household size. Eligible household sizes are one to four people. Applicants must occupy the unit as their primary residence. The property includes one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. Rent is set according to the applicable income tier; no separate cash grant is offered.
eligibility_conditions: Household gross annual income must not exceed 60% of area median income, adjusted for household size.
Household size must be one to four people.
claim_text: Households of up to four people with gross annual income at or below 60% of area median income may qualify for a rental home at Cedar Row Apartments.
housing_type: Income-restricted rental apartments with one-, two-, and three-bedroom units
